subject: Embeddings & Rerank: Transition checkpoints and customer cutover plan
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Olivia Barnes <olivia@acme.com>, Samir Patel <samir.p@acme.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Embeddings & Rerank: Transition checkpoints and customer cutover plan

Team / Olivia & Samir —

Thanks for the productive call today. As discussed, Acme is ready to cut over to our new embeddings + rerank flow, but we need a short coordinated plan to manage the index backfill and the initial rerank evaluation so the first production queries are smooth. I attached a draft backfill plan (acme_index_backfill_plan.xlsx) and a short checklist (cutover-checklist.md).

High-level asks from my side:
- Confirm maintenance window (1 hour preferred) and whether you want a canary phase (10% traffic) or staged rollout by product region.
- Confirm current vector DB endpoint and whether they can accept bulk import with upsert TTLs. If not, we need to run our streaming ingestion.
- Agree on rerank evaluation prompts and target acceptance thresholds (we recommended >85% precision@K for top-5 rerank).

I've proposed preliminary dates below — please reply with availability. I will own overall cutover coordination and rollback criteria.

Proposed schedule:
- Apr 20: Dry-run of backfill on small seed index (10k docs)
- Apr 22: Full index backfill (throttled) during 02:00–03:00 UTC
- Apr 23: Canary routings + rerank eval (10% traffic)
- Apr 25: Cutover to new rerank pipeline (regional stagger)

Attachments: acme_index_backfill_plan.xlsx, cutover-checklist.md

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Customer Success (Redwood Inference)
markus_klein@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acme.com>, Samir Patel <samir.p@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embeddings & Rerank: Transition checkpoints and customer cutover plan

Markus — thanks for the notes. A few quick items from the CSM/implementation side after scanning the backfill plan:

1) Vector DB: Acme currently uses vectordb.acme.internal (managed). They said bulk import is supported but rate-limited to 50k vectors/min. We should confirm whether that rate remains during the maintenance window.

2) Seed index size: their test cluster has ~28k docs with avg vector dim 1536; full production is estimated at ~1.2M docs. Backfill strategy should include a seeded prefix + streaming tail.

3) Rerank eval: I propose we run two eval passes during the canary:
   - Static eval against the provided labeled set (rerank-eval-results.pdf attached after internal run)
   - Live eval on 10% traffic using instrumentation we can flip off quickly if metrics regress

4) Owners: I can own the data verification checklist and sampling of queries. Marissa — can you confirm the eval prompt set and whether the scoring is compatible with their relevance labels?

I'll reach out to Acme infra to lock the maintenance window.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
monica_patel@redwood.com

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acme.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embeddings & Rerank: Transition checkpoints and customer cutover plan

Thanks, Markus and Monica — this looks straightforward from our side. A few clarifications: we can confirm a maintenance window Apr 22 02:00–03:00 UTC; bulk import rate is 60k vectors/min for the window (we bumped quota).

Notes for your team:
- Our production schema has doc_id, title, body, created_at, and a float[1536] vector field. We will provide a sample export (attached) to validate mapping.
- We prefer canary-by-product (search ecommerce first, then docs search) rather than traffic percentage. That aligns with our risk model.

If you want to run a dry-run on Apr 20, Samir and I can provide a tiny slice of prod (10k rows).

On the rerank eval thresholds — the business team expects minimal visible regression for commerce search; if precision@5 falls below 80% we should halt the canary.

Olivia Barnes
Head of Search Engineering — Acme, Inc.
olivia@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acme.com>, Samir Patel <samir.p@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embeddings & Rerank: Transition checkpoints and customer cutover plan

Folks — attaching a more prescriptive checklist and evaluation plan (rerank-eval-results.pdf attached as internal draft). Key operational checkpoints I've added: 

- Dry-run (Apr 20): validate mapping, run small backfill (10k), verify vector norms and embedding distribution plots. Owner: Monica
- Backfill strategy (Apr 22): chunk size 25k docs, 20s pause between chunks; monitor vector DB queue depth and write latency. Owner: Eng-Ops (TBD).
- Canary (Apr 23): canary-by-product as Acme requested (commerce -> docs). Run static eval, then live eval. Metric gates: precision@5 >= 0.80 for commerce, mean reciprocal rank (MRR) non-decreasing.
- Observability: add rerank latency histogram and top-k mismatch rate to dashboard; sample 500 queries for manual QA.
- Rollback triggers: precision@5 delta <-0.05 absolute OR 99th percentile latency increase > 150ms.

Attachment references: rerank-eval-results.pdf (internal draft), cutover-checklist.md.

Two questions for Markus: 1) Do we want Redwood to own the canary routing config or provide runbook and hand it to Acme infra? 2) Are we shipping a short post-cutover regression report to the business (I recommend yes).

—Marissa
Principal Solutions Engineer
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Olivia Barnes <olivia@acme.com>, Samir Patel <samir.p@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embeddings & Rerank: Transition checkpoints and customer cutover plan

Thanks everyone — great alignment. Finalizing owners and a short timeline below. If there are no objections by EOD tomorrow we'll lock these and push calendar invites.

Owners / commitments:
- Dry-run (Apr 20): Monica (data verification) + Acme infra (sample slice)
- Backfill (Apr 22): Eng-Ops executes (Marissa to provide runbook), Red/Acme runbook in Drive
- Canary (Apr 23): Marissa to configure canary-by-product; Monica to run live eval sampling
- Cutover (Apr 25): Laura to coordinate internal comms and rollback readiness; Markus to approve go/no-go

Rollback and metrics gates (repeat):
- Stop if precision@5 < 0.80 for commerce during canary
- Stop if top-k mismatch rate increases by >8% absolute
- Stop if 99th pct latency increases >150ms

Deliverables before dry-run:
- Confirmed maintenance window (Olivia) — received
- Mapping sample and export (Acme) — received
- Finalized runbook (Marissa) — draft attached

I'll schedule a 30m sync for Apr 19 to walk the runbook and confirm alerting. Thank you all for moving quickly.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
